purpose: Define the source-agnostic Tier-1 claim-to-keep giveaway data plane for Kazakhstan without changing paid ranking/Taste semantics.

ownership.writer_rule: Only the canonical giveaway producer may write data/production/giveaways/**. The existing Steam collector remains the sole writer of data/production/freebies.tsv and data/production/freebies_index.json.
ownership.steam_candidate_dependency: The giveaway producer reads the existing Steam KZ freebies artifacts only as candidate discovery and never rewrites them.

cadence.owner: existing GitHub-owned daily Steam KZ production workflow
cadence.rule: A consumer must not treat a snapshot as fresh after fresh_until_utc. Offer promotion_end_utc remains an earlier hard expiry when applicable.

accepted_offer_contract.temporal_rule: promotion_end_utc must be known and generated_at_utc must be before it; promotion_start_utc may be null only when current first-party source evidence independently proves the offer is active now
accepted_offer_contract.claim_url_rule: direct first-party HTTPS store/claim URL is mandatory

first_party_validation: Steam app page requested with cc=KZ
steam.acceptance_extra: 0 price + positive discount is candidate-only. Publication additionally requires full-game type, KZ availability, paid base or explicit giveaway evidence, explicit permanent-claim evidence and a known future promotion deadline.

gog.temporal_validation: first-party GOG product page must expose a parseable Offer ends on deadline for an accepted zero-price paid-base offer

dedup.raw_identity: source_offer_id is authoritative at normalized offer layer
dedup.cross_store_grouping: Only exact normalized title plus exact normalized publisher-set equality may auto-group in V1; otherwise preserve source-specific game identity.
dedup.offer_preservation: Grouping must retain every store-specific source_offer_id, deadline and claim URL.

completeness.overall_complete_rule: snapshot_status=complete only when Steam, Epic and GOG source_health.complete are all true for the current run
completeness.required_source_failure_rule: Persist an explicit incomplete snapshot; never reuse stale rows as current acceptance truth.
completeness.expired_offer_rule: An offer whose promotion_end_utc is at or before generated_at_utc cannot appear in accepted games even if a stale source response still contains it.
